villain.name: Dino-Day
villain.appearance: towers over everyone, scaly, always wears a bright pink shirt - a deliberately funny contrast with how scary he's trying to be
villain.wants: Desperately wants everyone to think he's the greatest, even though he's actually dumb and unpleasant - his cruelty is really insecurity in disguise.
villain.signatureBeat: TukuruMukuru once punched him so hard his two front teeth flew out - he's been a little gap-toothed and sensitive about it ever since, and it comes up again whenever he gets beaten.
villain.tone: Real tension when he's active - TukuruMukuru genuinely worries about him - but always played comedic overall, never grim.
